resourceCount.description: All known owned resources across descendants, including nested boundary CRs and obsolete resources. Excludes this root CR; each owned resource counts once.

terminatingResources.description: Known owned resources awaiting deletion across descendants.

capacityPlans.description: Known active capacity plans across observed graph instances.

capacityRequestedPods.description: Future Pods in active capacity plans.

capacityReadyPods.description: Future Pods with last-observed usable capacity.

capacityFailedPlans.description: Failed or expired capacity plans requiring a retry.

polyad_types.resources.status.RollupMetr.description: Recursive status fold across mixed graph types. Local leaves are combined with each child subtree exactly once. Missing or stale summaries are omitted and flagged.

name.description: Nested instance name in the parent namespace.

phase.description: Last reported lifecycle phase; consult current before using it.

observedGeneration.description: Child generation evaluated by its metrics.

current.description: Whether child lifecycle and metrics observations match its generation and it is not terminating. This is generation freshness, not a heartbeat.

topology.description: Boundary-local graph shape. Nested Graph, PolyGraph and ReplicaGroup instances count as single nodes. Duplicate directed edges are collapsed.

execution.description: Fresh observations for nodes in this boundary. Counts overlap: a completed Job can also be ready. Terminating or failed execution retains slots until cleanup or completion.

polyad_types.resources.status.SubgraphMe.description: Identity and freshness of a nested graph boundary.

nodeCount.description: Number of nodes in this graph or induced observed subset.

subgraphCount.description: Number of immediate nested Graph, PolyGraph and ReplicaGroup nodes.

admission.description: Acyclic lifecycle dependencies used for admission.

connections.description: Directed data-flow connections, which may contain cycles. Isolated nodes are included in component counts.

polyad_types.resources.status.TopologyMe.description: Boundary-local graph shape. Nested Graph, PolyGraph and ReplicaGroup instances count as single nodes. Duplicate directed edges are collapsed.

minimum.description: Inclusive nonnegative minimum; raise it to reject sparse bottlenecks, or omit for no lower bound.

maximum.description: Inclusive nonnegative maximum; lower it to require a sparse cut, or omit for no upper bound.

polyad_types.rules.Cheeger.description: Bound exact edge expansion on the simple undirected projection. A cut's ratio is its crossing-edge count divided by its smaller side's vertex count. The constant is the minimum ratio over all cuts. Raising the minimum rejects severe structural bottlenecks; lowering the maximum requires a sparse cut. Throughput policies can select these structural targets using application-reported rates; the constant itself is edge expansion.

maxVertices.description: Boundary vertex cap; null inherits the operator ceiling, normally 20.

maxCuts.description: Unique cut evaluation budget; null inherits the operator ceiling, normally 524287.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative time budget; null inherits the operator ceiling, normally five seconds.

priorityCuts.description: Ordered vertex subsets to examine before exhaustive search; complements are equivalent.

polyad_types.rules.CheegerComputation.description: Budget exact cut search and examine important partitions first without weakening bounds.

minConnectivity.description: Minimum second eigenvalue of the combinatorial Laplacian.

polyad_types.rules.Spectrum.description: Bound the spectrum of the simple undirected projection of a graph relation.

scope.description: Whether selected rules propagate to descendant boundaries.

enforcement.description: Mandatory namespace policy or explicitly selected rule.

relation.description: Directed edge relation used for local measurements.

limits.description: Inclusive upper bounds on named combinatorial measurements.

spectrum.description: Optional undirected spectral constraints, limited to 256 vertices.

network.description: Mandatory or referenced traffic restrictions inherited by graph descendants.

cheegerComputation.description: Cut priorities and per-calculation budgets within operator ceilings.

polyad_types.rules.StructuralRule.description: Apply reusable mathematical constraints to each graph boundary and its subtree.

enabled.description: Whether this workload requires persistent storage.

storageClass.description: Required StorageClass name, matching the existing PVC.

mountPath.description: Absolute storage mount path in application containers.
